title: Write config.json to demo directories when copied
description: Ensure that when demo directories are copied/created, a config.json file is automatically written to them. This provides users with a starting configuration in each demo.

title: Support list of models per entry instead of single string
description: Modify the config structure and code to handle a list of models for each entry rather than a single model string. This will allow running evaluations against multiple models per entry.

title: Pull default config into config.json in microeval directory
description: Extract the hardcoded default configuration and move it into a config.json file in the microeval directory. This will make the default configuration more visible and easier to modify.
